decisions.summary: Do not move FieldFrame into composites/form while labeled form controls remain atoms.
decisions.reason: InputText, ChoiceCheckbox, and siblings import FieldFrame. COMPOSITE sits above atom, so an atom cannot import a composite helper. Moving FieldFrame now would either break import direction or force a silent atom-to-composite re-tier of every labeled control in the same patch. Dropzone and ImageDropzone can move alone because they do not feed other atoms.
decisions.next: After Choice*/Input* labeled members become composites (or vendor-only Base atoms plus composite wrappers), move FieldFrame with them and replace children/skeletonControl with a buildable control slot.
